title: ERMIS-3 CubeSat establishes laser communication link with ground station
excerpt: The 8U CubeSat successfully transmitted data to the Holomondas Optical Ground Station in Greece using an optical terminal.
bodyHtml:
The European Space Agency announced on November 2, 2026, that the ERMIS-3 CubeSat has established an optical communication link with a ground station. Developed by the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens, the 8U satellite used an ATLAS-1 optical terminal to transmit data via narrow laser beams rather than conventional radio-frequency communications.

The connection was made with the Holomondas Optical Ground Station in Greece, which features a terminal from the Lithuanian company Astrolight. This operation marks the first optical link between a low Earth orbit satellite and a ground station in Greece.

The mission is part of the National Space Programme, which is implemented by the European Space Agency on behalf of the Greek government. The satellite was launched on 30 March 2026 alongside ERMIS-1 and ERMIS-2.
